changelog: Detect when the backend has lost track of this agent: health is now measured by application-level replies (heartbeat acks), not network pings, which an edge proxy can answer on the server's behalf while the backend behind it knows nothing about us
Reconnect automatically in that case instead of sitting 'connected' until someone restarts the agent by hand
Only ever run one reconnect at a time, so a close event and a forced disconnect can no longer each start their own chain and open duplicate sockets

Watchdog no longer restarts the process merely because the server is unreachable — the reconnect loop handles outages, and restarting during one risked tripping the supervisor's crash-loop backoff and leaving the farm dark for minutes
